title: JobInputRequest
description: Worker -> coordinator. The delegated model asked for something it was not given and the job is paused. Sent instead of job_result.schema.json: the job has not finished, it is waiting. The coordinator parks the job, surfaces the request to the caller, and re-leases the job with the answer appended once one arrives.

lease_id.description: Required: a superseded generation must not be able to park a job another worker is live on.

request_id.description: Worker-minted, unique within the job. Correlates the answer with the question, which is what makes resuming idempotent.

requests.description: The model's tool-call arguments, forwarded verbatim. The coordinator owns the translation into whatever the caller's protocol expects, so a change there never requires a worker rollout.

assistant_message.description: The assistant turn that made the request, including its tool_calls. The coordinator appends it to the conversation so the resumed job reads as one continuous exchange.

usage.description: What the job consumed up to the pause. Partial by definition; nothing is lost when it parks.
